project_overview: This Vue.js project appears to be a web application focused on exam and registration management. The core functionality revolves around student data, exam submissions, and results processing. The application utilizes a series of Vue components, likely managed through a router, to provide a user-friendly interface. The project exhibits a relatively shallow component structure primarily driven by route navigation.

layers.description: Handles user interaction and UI rendering.
Implements the core business rules and processes of the application.

macro_trends.title: High-Level View Component Over-Reliance
macro_trends.description: Several key views (e.g., ResultPage, iLikeCourses, iLikeLanding) are imported directly into other components, introducing potential dependency issues and increased coupling. This suggests a lack of separation of concerns and potential fragility if these core views are modified.

macro_trends.title: Route-Driven Component Composition
macro_trends.description: The heavy reliance on Router navigation to transition between components introduces a rigid structure. Changes to routes could lead to widespread cascading changes across the application, making refactoring difficult.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: This workflow starts with a user completing the ExamFormSubmission.vue, which then potentially triggers data validation and processing before rendering the ResultPage.vue, displaying the exam results.

key_workflows.name: Registration and Enrollment Workflow
key_workflows.description: Users navigate through a series of views (e.g., iLikeCourses.vue, iLikeCoursesNew.vue) to select courses, and ultimately potentially reach the FeeDetails.vue to handle payments and record enrollment information.
